overrides.name: Titan Shield
overrides.source_note: Upstream research 2004950139 / buff 171306920 / loca 53010: Decreases opponent's Shield Mitigation against non-Armada Hostiles while Fortified (ranks 1-10: 0.04..0.30). Gated on Titan-A Fortify via TITAN_A_FORTIFY_GATED_COMBAT_RESEARCH_RIDS. Live-verified 2026-11-28 across 6 U.S.S. Dauntless vs L65 Imperial Starfleet Planet Harvester fights with Max Fortification: outbound shield mitigation 0.3750 (R1-R2) / 0.4000 (R3+: 0.80 - 0.10 WOK Scotty - 0.30 Titan Shield), inbound shield mitigation 0.8250 (R1-R2) / 0.8000 (R3+: untouched by Titan Shield). Negative additive scalar subtracts from opponent shield mitigation; never an own shield bonus.

overrides.name: Titan Trigger
overrides.source_note: Upstream research 1947967502 / buff 3645831022 / loca 53021: Increases number of shots per weapon for 3 rounds while Max Fortified (ranks 1-5: 0.30, 0.55, 0.80, 1.05, 1.55). Gated on Titan-A Max Fortification via TITAN_MAX_FORTIFICATION_GATED_RESEARCH_RIDS. Live-verified 2026-11-28 across 6 U.S.S. Dauntless vs L65 Imperial Starfleet Planet Harvester fights (lv5 = +1.55): kinetic weapons fired round_half_even(2 * 2.55) = 5 shots and energy weapons fired round_half_even(3 * 2.55) = 8 shots in rounds 1-3, reverting to 2 and 3 shots in round 4+.

overrides.name: Titan Patch
overrides.source_note: Upstream research 3706606658 / buff 2604396570 / loca 53017: Restores Shield Health every round while Max Fortified (ranks 1-10: 0.05..0.30). Gated on Titan-A Max Fortification via TITAN_MAX_FORTIFICATION_GATED_RESEARCH_RIDS. Live-verified 2026-11-28 across 6 U.S.S. Dauntless vs L65 Imperial Starfleet Planet Harvester fights: 0.04 (SNW M'Benga) + 0.16 (Seska) + 0.30 (Titan Patch lv10) = 0.50 * max SHP restored every round.
